chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa'dan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever trims his moustache, clips his nails, and washes his head with the hibiscus on the day of Friday, he is like the one who emancipated a slave.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for grooming and washing the head with hibiscus on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi links the Friday grooming ritual (Tayammum al-Jumu'ah) to the high spiritual merit of freeing a slave, emphasizing the Prophetic tradition of preparing for congregational prayer. It underscores the Shia view that physical cleanliness is an integral component of spiritual devotion, particularly on the most significant day of the week.
